_comment: Pins OPEN -> EXPIRED (RFC-MACP-0001 Section 7.2, Section 7.3; RFC-MACP-0003 Section 2). Clocked: the harness opens the session at acceptance time 0 with Envelope timestamp 0, so the deadline is 1000. Every Envelope timestamp stays at the harness default of 0, so a runtime that times the TTL off the Envelope clock (contrary to RFC-MACP-0001 Section 7.6 item 4) never expires the session and fails the final-state check.
description: Core lifecycle: a session whose TTL elapses is EXPIRED and rejects further messages.

messages._comment: RFC-MACP-0001 Section 7.2/7.3 and RFC-MACP-0003 Section 2: the deadline is the SessionStart's acceptance time 0 plus ttl_ms 1000. At acceptance time 1500 the session has expired, so the Vote is rejected with a non-OPEN session error.
